Verses.26: Dear siblings, fellow children of Abraham and those among you who fear God, this message of salvation has been sent to us.
Verses.27: For the people of Jerusalem and their rulers did not recognize Jesus. Neither did they understand the utterances of the prophets being read every sabbath. In their condemning of Him, their words were fulfilled.
Verses.28: Though they found no grounds for putting Him to death, they asked Pilate to have Him executed.
Verses.29: They had carried out all that was written about Him. And after, they took Him down from the cross and laid Him in a tomb.
Verses.30: But God raised Him from the dead!
Verses.31: For many days, He appeared to those who traveled with Him from Galilee to Jerusalem. These very ones are now His witnesses to the people.

Changes: 2025-04-06 - Paul Prins: First translation of verses 26-31 based on Greek.
